name: turbo-mod
description: A side pane for Claude Code with collapsible widgets: files Claude wrote, terminal splits and the state of your git repos, in retro colors.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Retro color scheme of the pane. "standard" follows the theme of Claude Code. The arrows in the pane or /turbo theme <name> switch it for this machine.

reposRoot.title: Repo folder
reposRoot.description: Folder that holds your git repos, several separated by a semicolon. Empty means: pick it in the pane, use /turbo repos <path> or the environment variable TURBO_MOD_REPOS.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane. The button in the pane or /turbo lang <de|en> switches it for this machine.

ticketUrl.title: Ticket address
ticketUrl.description: Address of a ticket with the placeholder {id}, for example https://jira.example.com/browse/{id}. A ticket key in a branch name then becomes a link.

ticketFeed.title: Ticket feed
ticketFeed.description: Command that prints new tickets as JSON. Setting it switches on the widget New tickets, empty leaves it off. See the README for the format.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: Program the button next to a file starts in a new split.
